On the right, The Federalist suggested the ruling was wrongful, while a second Federalist headline introduced a process-based accusation that liberal justices "slow-walked" dissents to sabotage Trump's order. Breitbart went furthest, quoting Trump's characterization of mail voting as a "'Totally Corrupt'" "'Disaster,'" amplifying his framing approvingly rather than reporting it critically.
